date_note: The page gives only its publication day, 25 November.
title: Winston-Salem warns of scammers posing as Planning and Development Services with fake invoices
summary: WXII reports that the City of Winston-Salem says scammers are pretending to be its Planning and Development Services and emailing fake invoices and payment requests to people in planning, zoning and development. The city says the emails use city employees' names and addresses resembling official ones, and that official invoices and payments go through its portal.
plain: Winston-Salem says scammers are emailing fake invoices in the name of its Planning and Development Services. The city says official payments go only through its portal.
exec: Fake invoices posing as city staff target people doing development business with the city.
action: The city advises being cautious of payment requests outside its portal, contacting Winston-Salem police on 336-773-7700 about suspicious emails and keeping the email for investigators.

validation.note: Only WXII read, relaying the city's warning; the city page was not read.
